name: Inkerman
why: Footwear and clothing from Nantucket and New York, with loafers, linen jackets and cotton knits made in Portugal, and two stores of its own, in New York and Nantucket.
origin: Founded around 2018 in Nantucket, Massachusetts, by Thomas and Will (the brand gives no surnames). The brand dates its first jacket to 2018 and says it started “with a Vespa” eight years ago.

onething.n: The brand calls it “our best selling product ever,” first introduced in 2018, an unlined 520gsm Irish linen chore jacket made by jacket specialists in Porto.

T-shirt.hp: Sailboat American Flag Tee / Whale Skeleton Tee (same $75; only graphic tees sold)

Polo.hp: Long Sleeve Knit Polo in Navy Stripe

Outerwear.hp: Railway WV Men's Jacket in French Blue (unlined 520gsm Irish linen chore jacket)

Shoes.lp: The Hugo Sneaker (loafer is the staple; cheapest loafer is Madaket/Charlie $285)
